title: bridelia neogoetzea
intro: Bridelia neogoetzea, commonly known as the Bridelia or Eurya, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Africa and Asia. It is a shrub or small tree with a variety of medicinal properties, used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Bridelia neogoetzea include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic effects.
